title: Model ML raises $250 million at $1.5 billion valuation, 18 months after launching from stealth - Model ML
summary: Model ML raises $250M Series B at a $1.5B valuation, led by General Atlantic and QED, to bring personal AI agents to every banker and investor.
body_markdown:
###### *Round co-led by General Atlantic and QED Investors takes total funding raised to $350 million as banks, consulting firms and asset managers worldwide deploy personal AI agents across their businesses*


NEW YORK and LONDON, 17 November 2026. Model ML today announced it has raised $250 million in Series B funding at a $1.5 billion valuation. The round was co-led by[General Atlantic](https://www.generalatlantic.com/) , a leading global investor, and[QED Investors](https://www.qedinvestors.com/) , a leading global fintech specialist, with participation from[Evolution Equity Partners](https://evolutionequity.com/) ,[Airtree](https://www.airtree.vc/) ,[Forestay Capital](https://www.forestay.vc/) ,[Y Combinator](https://www.ycombinator.com/) ,[FT Partners](https://ftpartners.com/) ,[Latitude](https://www.phoenixcourt.vc/funds/latitude) ,[Inception Fund](https://inceptionfund.vc/) and[13Books Capital](https://13bookscapital.com/) , bringing the company’s total funding raised to $350 million.


In the third quarter of 2026, Model ML’s annual recurring revenue grew 12x year on year and daily active users increased 26x. To support this growth, Model ML will use the funding to expand its research and engineering teams in London and New York to deepen product innovation and support wider customer deployments. Offices opened this year in Paris, Madrid, Tokyo, Singapore and Dubai will help the company serve clients wherever their teams work.


Founded by brothers and repeat entrepreneurs Chaz and Arnie Englander, Model ML gives every banker, consultant and investor their own personal AI agent. It understands their clients, their live deals and how they like things done. It runs on the firm’s systems and data, works around the clock and becomes more personalised with every interaction.


The agent does not wait for instructions. It anticipates what matters, filters out the noise and executes. When news breaks on a company a banker covers, it does not simply send an alert. It judges whether the development matters, works through the implications and prepares the analysis in the firm’s own formats, in minutes rather than days. By the time the banker needs it, the work is already done.


Model ML offers flexible deployment models, and often deploys within its customers’ own infrastructure, so their data does not need to leave their environment. Customer data is never used to train AI models, allowing institutions to preserve their proprietary edge. Model ML is ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified and SOC 2 Type II audited.


“AI should do more than give you another answer or notification. It should understand your work and get things done,” said Chaz Englander, Co-founder and CEO of Model ML. “That means knowing what matters, doing the work in the background and bringing you something finished. We’re building a personal AI agent for every banker, consultant and investor, working 24/7 inside the systems their firm already trusts.”


Model ML is not tied to any single AI provider. It benchmarks models on real financial work and routes each task to the best model for quality, speed and cost. A growing share of that work runs on Model ML’s own fine-tuned open-source models. On the workloads they handle, these models run at 2% of the cost of frontier models and are, in most cases, five times faster, with accuracy that matches or beats the frontier on those tasks.


“Model ML is purpose-built for financial and professional services at a time when these institutions are moving quickly from AI experimentation to everyday use. We see a significant opportunity for the platform to become core to how these firms operate, with customers already trusting it with increasingly complex work,” said Paul Stamas, Managing Director and Global Head of Financial Services at General Atlantic. “Model ML’s pace of customer adoption shows that momentum is inflecting and reflects the team’s highly focused approach to innovation and execution.”


“In more than 40 years of building and backing financial services companies, I have not seen a team build faster,” said Nigel Morris, Co-founder and Managing Partner of QED Investors. “Eighteen months ago, Model ML was emerging from stealth. Today, its product is deeply embedded inside some of the world’s largest institutions.”


The fundraise follows a $75 million Series A led by FT Partners in November 2025, with participation from Y Combinator, LocalGlobe, Latitude, 13Books Capital and QED Investors.


###### About Model ML


Model ML is the personal AI platform for financial and professional services. It gives bankers, consultants and investors an agent that understands their work, acts on their behalf and delivers finished output within their firm’s systems. Headquartered in London, with offices in New York, Paris, Madrid, Tokyo, Singapore and Dubai, Model ML is backed by investors including QED Investors, General Atlantic, FT Partners, Y Combinator, LocalGlobe and HSBC Asset Management. Its advisory board includes Sir Noel Quinn, former Group Chief Executive of HSBC, and Axel Weber, former Chairman of UBS. www.modelml.com


###### About General Atlantic


General Atlantic is a leading global investor with more than four and a half decades of experience providing capital and strategic support for over 905 companies throughout its history. Established in 1980, General Atlantic continues to be a dedicated partner to visionary founders and investors seeking to build dynamic businesses and create lasting value. Guided by the conviction that entrepreneurs can be incredible agents of transformational change, the firm combines a collaborative global approach, sector specific expertise, a long-term investment horizon, and a deep understanding of growth drivers to partner with and scale innovative businesses around the world. The firm leverages its patient capital, operational expertise, and global platform to support a diversified investment platform spanning Growth Equity, Infrastructure, and Strategic Solutions. General Atlantic manages approximately $135 billion in assets under management, inclusive of all strategies, as of September 30, 2026, with more than 900 professionals in 20 countries across five regions. For more information on General Atlantic, please visit www.generalatlantic.com.


###### About QED Investors


QED Investors is a leading global venture capital firm based in Alexandria, Va. Founded in 2007, QED invests in companies that are reimagining the future of financial services. Led by Co-Founder and Managing Partner Nigel Morris, the firm builds durable businesses through a hands-on approach that draws on its partners’ decades of entrepreneurial and operational experience to help companies achieve breakout growth. QED has backed more than 250 companies worldwide, including early investments in Credit Karma, Kavak, Klarna, Nubank, Remitly and SoFi. The firm manages approximately $4.4 billion in assets and is currently investing across stages from nearly $1 billion in combined funds.
